scenario: Splitting categories for dual-intent concepts per LFAC.4.6 — if a concept has both event and state aspects, split into two schemas (`FooEvent ttl` + `Foo logical`) rather than conflating. Author guidance, no enforcement; the spec recommends the pattern. Pinned via compile_ok of a paired-schema example demonstrating the legality of the recommended shape.
rules_ds:
schema MotionEvent scope ttl 5_s:
    source: String

schema MotionState scope logical:
    source: String key

rule arrive:
    MotionEvent m
->
    emit MotionState logical source: m.source
